explainer.counted: Refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo in Kenya on 31 December 2025, as reported to UNHCR.
explainer.type: A stock: people present at the end of the year, not the number who arrived that year.
explainer.not_included: Asylum seekers, people never registered, and people counted under other groups.
explainer.reliability: Reported to UNHCR, often by the host government. The data does not say, row by row, whether a figure is a government count, a registration count or an estimate.

footnotes.fn_17ec91af: The figure of 20,000 is an estimate by UNHCR and civil society organizations based on currently available information on several communities in Kenya. This estimate is under review pending further research and mapping activities.
footnotes.fn_249b44dc: The figure is based on an estimate of 18,500 in 2019 by UNHCR with input from stateless communities of whom 1,670 stateless persons of Shona descent were granted Kenyan citizenship in 2020. In 2023, approximately 7,000 individuals from the Pemba community had their nationality confirmed. An official government report on the Pemba registration exercise is yet to be released and statistics will be updated accordingly. As of end-2024, the figure of 9,800 stateless persons in Kenya remains an estimate.
footnotes.fn_274931b2: The IDP figure differs from those agreed and communicated by UN OCHA, given the exlusion of IDPs due to disasters, in line with UNHCR methodology.
